posts.title: The Claude Delusion
posts.description: I'm smarter than anybody else. I built AI, ergo AI is amazing. But AI surprised me, too, ergo AI is by definition superhuman. It all makes sense, see.

posts.title: This is not sustainable
posts.description: Cyber Defense teams are suffering a DDoS; vulnerability management is no longer able to keep up with the onslaught of findings, reports, nor hype. The current situation is simply not sustainable.

posts.title: 'Winning AI'
posts.description: 'Winning AI' - I still don't know what that is supposed to mean. But I know I'm already tired of it.
